about.intro: We shape *identities* and **digital experiences** with a clear point of view.
about.description: Studio Halden is an independent design practice focused on **identity**, *digital experience*, and image-making. We turn ideas into coherent visual systems designed to be understood, remembered, and used.
about.full:
Studio Halden works across **brand identity**, *digital experience*, and visual communication. We begin by finding the central idea: the one thought that can guide language, typography, imagery, motion, and every point of contact.

Our process moves between direction and making. We test concepts in real applications early, so the identity is not only distinctive in a presentation but useful in the world.

The public portfolio is currently being assembled. The projects shown in this preview are clearly labelled **concept studies** and will be replaced with approved studio work before launch.

AI may support exploration and production behind the scenes. What clients see is the final design thinking, craft, and outcome.

projects.title: Field Notes
projects.description: A provisional identity study exploring how a restrained typographic system can hold editorial, packaging, and digital applications together. The image is temporary and will be replaced with approved studio work.

projects.title: Signal / Noise
projects.description: A provisional digital experience study built around contrast, rhythm, and progressive disclosure. It demonstrates how a strong interface can feel expressive while keeping the work easy to browse.

projects.title: Afterimage
projects.description: A provisional campaign world designed as a flexible image and motion system rather than a single key visual. The final case study will be replaced when approved portfolio material is available.

roadmap.description: We clarify the audience, context, constraints, and the decision the design needs to influence.
We turn the brief into a small set of visual territories and choose the idea with the strongest potential.
We build the core identity and test it across the surfaces that matter most to the project.
We review the system in context, sharpen the details, and adapt it across formats and screen sizes.
We prepare the final assets, rules, and reusable components so the work can continue consistently.
